post.summary: [Mọi vai trò] Ký lượt tải ảnh đại diện lên Cloudinary
post.description: ADR-0064. Every account role, for its own account only. Returns `data` as `{uploadUrl, fields, storedUrl, maxBytes}`: POST the image as `file` with every entry of `fields` (multipart) to `uploadUrl`, then save `storedUrl` with `PUT /api/account/me/avatar`. The public ID is new on each call and sits under that account's own folder; Cloudinary stores the picture at most 1024 px. A deactivated account returns 403; a server without `Cloudinary` configuration returns 503 `AVATAR_UPLOAD_UNAVAILABLE`. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

Returns the updated profile with `avatarUrl` and records `AVATAR_UPDATED` or `AVATAR_REMOVED`. The old picture is not deleted from Cloudinary. post.summary: [Robot] Hỏi có cần bật camera Quest không
post.description: ADR-0052. Optional JSON body (ADR-0056), at most 1 KB: `{headset: {connection, batteryPercent, charging, stream, screen}}`, the headset as quest-stream read it over adb; `screen` is `awake`, `asleep` or `unknown`. Unknown words become `unknown` and the battery is clamped to 0–100, so a bad field never fails the poll. An older robot sends no body. Robot scheme only (`Authorization: Bearer`, `X-Robot-Code`); user JWTs get 401. Returns `data` as `{wanted, reason, pollSeconds, headsetCommand}`: `reason` is `TOUR_RUNNING`, `STAFF_WATCHING` or `IDLE`. The robot captures and publishes only while `wanted` is true and polls again after `pollSeconds`. `headsetCommand` is null or `{id, action}` with `action` `WAKE` or `SLEEP`, a Staff press handed out once (ADR-0056 addendum); the robot runs it on the headset and the next report shows `screen`. No SQL write. Shares the FleetSync rate limit.

post.summary: [Robot] Lấy lệnh hiện tại
post.description: Body `{streamId}`. Robot scheme only (`Authorization: Bearer`, `X-Robot-Code`); user JWTs get 401. Returns `data.command`: null, a GoTo or a Cancel, per docs/contracts/fleet-commands/v1. `streamId` must be the robot's current Fleet Sync stream, heard within `FleetCommands:MaxTelemetryAgeSeconds`, otherwise 409 `STREAM_NOT_CURRENT` and nothing is delivered. Repeating the poll returns the same command. A command delivered to an earlier stream becomes UNKNOWN and is never redelivered. A GoTo is handed out only while `FleetCommands:Enabled = true`, and a new one needs a RUNNING NORMAL Tour and a robot with `IsDispatchEnabled = 1`; a Cancel is always delivered, also while commands are off. Shares the FleetSync rate limit.

post.summary: [Robot] Báo kết quả lệnh
post.description: Body `{commandId, legId, streamId, reportedAt, phase, outcome, reason}`; `commandId` must equal the path (400). Answered only after the state change and its TourEvent commit: `data` is `{accepted, duplicate, commandState}`. An exact repeat returns `duplicate: true` with no effect. 404 `COMMAND_NOT_FOUND` for an unknown command or another robot's; 409 `RESULT_CONFLICT`, `RESULT_STREAM_MISMATCH`, `RESULT_PHASE_NOT_ALLOWED`. Recorded also while commands are off. Shares the FleetSync rate limit.

post.summary: [Robot] Báo cáo chẩn đoán phần cứng và ROS 2
post.description: Ingests periodic hardware, ROS 2 node, and sensor health diagnostics from an authenticated physical robot. Uses FleetRobot authentication scheme. Telemetry age and metric bounds are validated. post.summary: [Robot] Long poll lệnh xoay đầu quay
post.description: Body `{epoch, afterSeq, waitMs, head}`, at most 4 KB. Robot scheme only (`Authorization: Bearer`, `X-Robot-Code`); user JWTs get 401. Holds up to `FleetHead:MaxWaitMs` and returns `data.epoch` and the queued head commands after `afterSeq` (STEP, JOG, STOP or ANGLE, per docs/contracts/fleet-head/v1). A changed epoch means the API restarted and earlier commands are gone. Commands older than `FleetHead:MaxCommandAgeMs` are never delivered. The optional `head` reports the head's state for Staff. Answers also while `FleetHead:Enabled = false`. Has its own `FleetHead` rate limit, separate from Fleet Sync.

get.summary: [Robot] Lấy POI và hướng camera cho đầu quay tự động
get.description: ADR-0045 addendum 14/11/2026. No body. Robot scheme only (`Authorization: Bearer`, `X-Robot-Code`); user JWTs get 401. Returns `data` as `{source, tourId, mapVersionId, mode, autoMotion, pois}` per docs/contracts/fleet-head/v1: `source` is `TOUR` (the stops of the robot's RUNNING Tour), `MAP` (verified POIs on the robot's map) or `NONE`; each POI has `id`, `name`, `x`, `y`, `yaw` and `cameraPreset`. `autoMotion` is `FleetHead:Enabled` and AUTO mode; only then the robot turns the head by itself when a Nav2 goal starts or succeeds near a POI. No SQL write. Has its own `FleetHead` rate limit.

post.summary: [Technical Staff] Upload gói ROS map và tạo phiên bản
post.description: Validates a ROS map ZIP and stores an immutable map version for `areaKey`/`areaName`. Multipart fields: `requestId` (stable retry key for the same payload) and `package`; the server computes SHA-256 and allocates the next version under the area transaction lock. New areas are created with their first version and cannot reuse an existing area's name, trimmed and ignoring case (`MAP_AREA_NAME_TAKEN`, ADR-0066); existing area keys must retain their stored display name. Changing the payload requires a new requestId. Requires TechnicalStaff. Uploading validates and stores a package only: it does not deploy the map to a robot or establish deployment evidence. Invalid/oversized packages return 400; area name/idempotency/version conflicts return 409; role failures return 403. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

post.summary: [Technical Staff] Xem trước nhập POI từ file
post.description: Multipart fields: `mapVersionId`, `robotCode` and `files` (.yaml/.yml, at most 50 and 64 KB each, or one ZIP with them at its root). Returns per-file parsed pose, verified flag (what will be recorded), action (CREATE, NEW_REVISION, NO_CHANGE) or an error code with a Vietnamese message, and `robotReadiness` `{ready, code, message}` for the robot on that version (ADR-0066). Writes nothing. Requires TechnicalStaff. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

post.summary: [Technical Staff] Nhập POI từ file ghi pose
post.description: Same fields as preview plus `requestId` and required `evidenceNote`. All-or-nothing: any failing file returns 409 POI_IMPORT_INVALID with per-file errors and imports nothing. A verified file records a POSE_CAPTURE result that claims no reach, stop, localization or camera observation and stores the raw file and SHA-256; an unverified file, or any file while the robot is not ready on the version (ADR-0066), goes to the Technical verification queue. Retrying the same request returns the same result; the same file on the same map version is NO_CHANGE. Requires TechnicalStaff. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

get.summary: [Technical Staff/Admin/Staff] Liệt kê robot vật lý
get.description: Returns safe credential metadata, the inspection hold (`needsInspection`, `currentTourId`, `currentTourName`, `currentTourState`; ADR-0043 D13), first-accepted connection confirmation, current in-memory sync freshness, the database-assigned valid MapVersion and latest cross-map deployment check. Admin and Staff are read-only; only TechnicalStaff may change map assignment. No credential hash, secret, or unrelated settings are returned. Each robot carries `readiness` (`state` READY, NOT_READY or NOT_SET_UP, `reasonCode`, `reason`, `mapVersionId`, `mapLabel`, `deploymentCheckedAt`, `reportingOnAssignedMap`), the single rule of ADR-0066. Map checks remain manual observations. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

post.summary: [Technical Staff] Đăng ký danh tính robot vật lý
post.description: Registers only a robot identity using `robotCode` and `displayName`. RobotCode follows Fleet Sync v1 format and is limited to 100 characters; displayName is required and limited to 150. The server trims both values, sets `SourceType=PHYSICAL`, creates an unassigned, dispatch-disabled Robot row with a null credential hash, and appends an actor/time audit record in the same save transaction. Duplicate RobotCode returns 409 through the database unique constraint. Only TechnicalStaff may call this API. It does not provision a credential, connect to ROS2, mark the robot online/ready, or authorize dispatch. After issuing a credential, assign an uploaded map version to provide Fleet Sync context. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

Returns the SCHEDULED/READY Tours reserved on it; none is cancelled. IsDispatchEnabled is untouched. A robot running a Tour returns 409 `ROBOT_IN_RUNNING_TOUR` (ADR-0066 round 5). Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

Refused while the Tour holding the robot has not ended (`ROBOT_TOUR_ACTIVE`), while it has an open or unreconciled command (`ROBOT_COMMAND_OPEN`), or when it is not held (`ROBOT_NOT_HELD`); old version `STALE_VERSION` (409). Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

post.summary: [Technical Staff] Bật/tắt điều phối robot
post.description: Body `{requestId, expectedRowVersion, enabled, reason, evidenceRef}`. Turning off always works, even from a stale page. Turning on needs `evidenceRef` (the GATE A record) and an active robot (`ROBOT_DEACTIVATED`) with a key (`ROBOT_CREDENTIAL_REQUIRED`), an assigned map (`ROBOT_MAP_REQUIRED`), readiness on that map under ADR-0066 (`ROBOT_CONNECTION_UNCONFIRMED`, `ROBOT_DEPLOYMENT_CHECK_REQUIRED`) and no pending inspection (`ROBOT_NEEDS_INSPECTION`); old version `STALE_VERSION` (409). Audited as `ROBOT_DISPATCH_CHANGED`; a repeat with the same `requestId` replays. Does not stop a robot already moving. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

put.summary: [Technical Staff] Gán phiên bản bản đồ cho robot
put.description: Assigns a valid uploaded map version to a PHYSICAL robot. Body requires `requestId`, `expectedRowVersion` and `mapVersionId`; mapKey/frameId are derived from the immutable MapVersion, including when its technical check is not PASS. The transaction updates only the three assignment columns and appends an audit row. It does not change credentials or first-accepted confirmation. A stale rowVersion or conflicting replay returns 409. A robot running a Tour returns 409 `ROBOT_IN_RUNNING_TOUR` (ADR-0066 round 5). Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

delete.summary: [Technical Staff] Gỡ gán bản đồ khỏi robot
delete.description: Clears a PHYSICAL robot's assigned map context. Body requires `requestId` and `expectedRowVersion`. The transaction clears the three assignment columns and appends an audit row; subsequent Fleet Sync reports are rejected as unconfigured until a map is assigned again. A robot running a Tour returns 409 `ROBOT_IN_RUNNING_TOUR` (ADR-0066 round 5). Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

post.summary: [Technical Staff] Cấp credential Fleet Sync lần đầu
post.description: Compatibility endpoint addressed by physical robot ID. Issues a one-time credential only when the registered PHYSICAL robot has no active key. Body includes `requestId` and `expectedRowVersion`; plaintext is returned once with `Cache-Control: no-store`, only the hash is stored, and replay never returns the secret again. Credential metadata, confirmation reset and append-only audit commit atomically. Active key returns 409; stale row version/replayed request returns 409. The canonical endpoint uses RobotCode under `/api/technical/robots/{robotCode}/credential`. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

post.summary: [Technical Staff] Chủ động cấp lại credential Fleet Sync
post.description: Compatibility endpoint addressed by physical robot ID. Replaces the current PHYSICAL robot credential and resets all three persisted first-accepted confirmation fields in the same transaction. Body includes `requestId` and `expectedRowVersion`; the new plaintext is returned once with `Cache-Control: no-store`, the old token stops authenticating, and a replay never reveals the secret again. Requires TechnicalStaff. The canonical endpoint uses RobotCode under `/api/technical/robots/{robotCode}/credential/rotate`. A robot running a Tour returns 409 `ROBOT_IN_RUNNING_TOUR` (ADR-0066 round 5). Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

get.summary: [Tour Staff/Technical Staff] Xem các phiên bản map
get.description: Lists map metadata and backend-calculated technical check / POI-preparation state, optionally filtered by `areaKey`, with `take` capped by backend validation. Response includes `technicalCheckStatus`, `canUseForPoiPreparation`, block reason code/text, and the robot/time/check evidence used. Eligibility uses the latest check per exact map-version/physical-robot pair and requires matching package SHA-256 plus localization and display PASS; a newer FAIL supersedes that robot's earlier PASS. A passing check on another map version is not inherited. `currentlyDeployedOn` separately reports physical robots whose latest deployment check across all maps points to this exact map version with matching checksum and both observations passed. This read-only marker does not change historical POI eligibility or block selection. `runningRobot` is the active robot assigned to this version with its ADR-0066 `readiness`, or null; the web reads it instead of `currentlyDeployedOn`. Read permission is Staff or TechnicalStaff. This is recorded human evidence, not live robot inspection. Invalid `take` returns 400. Retired map versions (ADR-0041) are left out unless `includeRetired=true`, which Map Management uses; each map carries `status` (`ACTIVE` or `RETIRED`), `retiredAt`, `retiredByUserId`, `retiredByName`, `retirementReason` and an opaque `rowVersion` for retire. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

get.summary: [Tour Staff/Technical Staff] Xem chi tiết phiên bản map
get.description: Reads immutable map metadata and the same backend-calculated technical check / POI-preparation state returned by the list operation, including reason and source evidence. Eligibility uses the latest check per exact map-version/physical-robot pair and requires matching checksum, localization and display PASS. `currentlyDeployedOn` separately lists physical robots whose latest cross-map check points to this version with matching checksum and both observations passed. A recorded check is historical human-entered evidence, not live robot inspection; this marker does not change POI eligibility. `runningRobot` is the active robot assigned to this version with its ADR-0066 `readiness`, or null. Current permission is Staff or TechnicalStaff. Missing version returns 404. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

get.summary: [Tour Staff/Technical Staff] Tải gói map theo phiên bản
get.description: Downloads the exact stored ZIP for `id`; response includes a SHA-256 ETag for the immutable package. Current permission is Staff or TechnicalStaff. Downloading does not deploy the package. Missing version returns 404. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

post.summary: [Technical Staff] Ghi nhận kiểm tra triển khai map
post.description: Appends a manual deployment/localization/display check for map version `id`. Body fields include `requestId` (reuse unchanged for retry of the same payload), `robotCode`, exact `packageSha256`, `localizationPassed`, `displayPassed`, and required `evidenceNote`. Requires TechnicalStaff. The backend verifies the referenced physical robot and exact package checksum. ADR-0066: the robot must hold this map version (`ROBOT_MAP_NOT_ASSIGNED`, PASS or FAIL), and a PASS needs persisted connection confirmation (`ROBOT_CONNECTION_UNCONFIRMED`) and a fresh Fleet Sync report received since the assignment (`ROBOT_NOT_REPORTING`). Saving records that a human performed and reported the check. It does not load a map or control a robot. Invalid evidence returns 400; missing robot/version 404; conflicting idempotency or deployment state 409. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

get.summary: [Technical Staff] Xem lịch sử kiểm tra triển khai map
get.description: Returns append-only manual deployment-check records for map version `id`. Requires TechnicalStaff. The history records who submitted each check and does not query the robot. Missing version returns 404. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

get.summary: [Technical Staff] Xem ảnh hưởng khi ngừng sử dụng phiên bản bản đồ
get.description: Lists what retiring map version `id` would touch or be blocked by (ADR-0041): `routes` with any revision on it, active `assignedRobots`, submitted `pendingPois` and `pendingRoutes` still waiting for a technical result, and SCHEDULED or READY `upcomingTours` whose route revision uses it. Read-only; nothing is cancelled. Requires TechnicalStaff. Missing version returns 404. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

post.summary: [Technical Staff] Ngừng sử dụng phiên bản bản đồ
post.description: Retires map version `id` without deleting it (ADR-0041). Body `{ reason, expectedRowVersion }`; reason is required, at most 500 characters. Under the map version lock it refuses with 409 `MAP_VERSION_ROBOT_ASSIGNED` while an active robot is assigned the version, `MAP_VERSION_HAS_PENDING_REVIEWS` while a submitted POI or route revision on it waits for a technical result, and `MAP_VERSION_HAS_UPCOMING_TOURS` while a SCHEDULED or READY Tour uses a route on it; each lists the blocking items in `errors.blockers`. A stale `expectedRowVersion` returns 409 `MAP_VERSION_STALE`, so of two simultaneous retires one succeeds. Afterwards robot assignment, deployment checks, POI proposals, revisions, submissions and imports, route revisions and submissions, and Tour create and slots on the version return 409 `MAP_VERSION_RETIRED`; existing data stays readable. Audited as `MAP_VERSION_RETIRED`. Requires TechnicalStaff. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

post.summary: [Technical Staff] Mở lại phiên bản bản đồ
post.description: Lifts the retirement of map version `id` (ADR-0041): clears the three retirement fields and nothing else. Optional body `{ expectedRowVersion }`; a stale value returns 409 `MAP_VERSION_STALE`. Reopening an open version returns it unchanged. Audited as `MAP_VERSION_REOPENED`. Requires TechnicalStaff. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

post.summary: [Tour Staff] Tạo đề xuất POI chưa kiểm chứng
post.description: Creates a POI proposal and its first draft revision only when the exact map version has an effective successful manual technical check: the latest record for at least one physical robot must match the package checksum and pass localization and display. Upload/ZIP validation alone is not sufficient. Creation remains NOT_CHECKED for POI verification. A currently ineligible map returns 409 with a business reason; failed mutations create no proposal, revision, submission receipt or success audit. Requires Staff (Tour Staff product label). Invalid pose or request returns 400; missing map returns 404; reused requestId with different content returns 409. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

get.summary: [Tour Staff/Technical Staff] Liệt kê đề xuất POI
get.description: Lists proposals, optionally filtered by `mapVersionId`. Current read permission is Staff or TechnicalStaff. Results include current revision and technical status; submitting a proposal does not itself verify it. Invalid filter/input returns 400. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

get.summary: [Tour Staff/Technical Staff] Xem đề xuất POI và trạng thái
get.description: Reads a proposal by `id`, including its current `revision`, `rowVersion`, map version and verification status. Current read permission is Staff or TechnicalStaff. Missing proposal returns 404. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

get.summary: [Tour Staff/Technical Staff] Xem lịch sử revision và kiểm chứng POI
get.description: Returns immutable revisions and recorded verification history for proposal `id`. Current read permission is Staff or TechnicalStaff. History is scoped to the submitted revision/fingerprint and evidence captured for it. Missing proposal returns 404. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

get.summary: [Tour Staff] Xem Tour đã lên lịch đi qua POI
get.description: Lists SCHEDULED and READY Tours whose route revision stops at any revision of POI proposal `id`, soonest first, so Staff sees them before retiring the POI. Same item shape as `GET /api/staff/routes/{routeId}/scheduled-tours`. Read-only. Requires Staff. A missing proposal returns 404. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

put.summary: [Tour Staff] Tạo revision nháp cho đề xuất POI
put.description: Creates the next immutable draft revision only while the exact map version remains eligible for POI preparation. This gate applies also when changing the revision to another map. Body includes `requestId`, `expectedCurrentRevision`, `expectedRowVersion`, and draft fields including `mapVersionId`. Ineligible map state returns 409 with a reason. Requires Staff. Stale revision/rowVersion conflicts return 409. A movement-affecting change has a different navigation fingerprint and needs new POI technical verification; old revisions/results remain readable. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

post.summary: [Tour Staff] Gửi revision POI để kiểm chứng
post.description: Submits the current draft revision only while its exact map version remains eligible for POI preparation. Body includes `requestId`, `expectedRevisionNumber`, and `expectedRowVersion`. Ineligible map state returns 409 with a reason. Requires Staff. Submission does not mean the POI has passed. A stale or already-submitted state returns 409. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

post.summary: [Tour Staff] Xoá POI chưa nằm trong tuyến nào khỏi danh sách
post.description: Soft-discards a POI proposal none of whose revisions is a stop of any route revision, retired routes included (ADR-0051 amended by ADR-0062): one that never passed, or one that passed but no route uses. Body includes `expectedRevisionNumber` and `expectedRowVersion`. Nothing is deleted: revisions, submissions, results and import receipts remain readable by id and history, while staff lists and the verification queue omit the proposal. A proposal used by a route returns 409 `POI_PROPOSAL_IN_ROUTE`; a retired proposal returns 409 `POI_RETIRED`; a stale version returns 409 `STALE_VERSION`; repeating the request for an already discarded proposal returns it unchanged. The check runs under the proposal row lock that route save also takes. Later revise, submit, verify, re-import or route save returns 409 `POI_PROPOSAL_DISCARDED`. Requires Staff. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

post.summary: [Tour Staff] Ngưng dùng POI đã nằm trong tuyến
post.description: Retires a POI proposal that once passed and that a route revision uses, so it cannot be discarded (ADR-0062; `canRetire` on the view). Body `{ requestId, expectedRowVersion }`. Saved routes and Tours are unchanged. While retired, revise, submit, verify, narration save/approve/discard and pose import return 409 `POI_RETIRED`, the verification queue omits it, and route save refuses it with 409 `POI_RETIRED`. A proposal that can be discarded instead returns 409 `POI_NOT_RETIRABLE`; a discarded one 409 `POI_PROPOSAL_DISCARDED`; a stale version 409 `STALE_VERSION`; repeating the request for an already retired proposal returns it unchanged. Audited as `POI_PROPOSAL_RETIRED`. Requires Staff. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

post.summary: [Tour Staff] Dùng lại POI đã ngưng dùng
post.description: Lifts the retirement of POI proposal `id` (ADR-0062); nothing else changes. Body `{ requestId, expectedRowVersion }`. A stale version returns 409 `STALE_VERSION`; repeating the request for an active proposal returns it unchanged. Audited as `POI_PROPOSAL_REACTIVATED`. Requires Staff. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

get.summary: [Tour Staff/Technical Staff] Xem các phiên bản thuyết minh của POI
get.description: Lists every narration version of POI proposal `id` newest first (ADR-0060): `state` (`DRAFT`, `APPROVED`, `SUPERSEDED`, `DISCARDED`), text, optional HTTPS fallback video, author, last editor and approver with names and times, and an opaque `rowVersion`. Discarded POIs stay readable. Unknown POI returns 404. Requires Staff or TechnicalStaff. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

put.summary: [Tour Staff] Viết hoặc sửa bản đang soạn của thuyết minh POI
put.description: Creates the POI's narration draft when it has none (omit `expectedRowVersion`) or edits the current draft in place (send its `expectedRowVersion`); a mismatch either way returns 409 `STALE_VERSION`. Body `{ requestId, expectedRowVersion?, narrationText, fallbackVideoUrl? }`; text trimmed, 1–4000 characters; `fallbackVideoUrl` is still accepted but ignored: a POI narration stores no video (the Tour's own fallback video is the one students see), and a route revision copies none to its stops. Independent of the POI's technical result. A discarded POI returns 409 `POI_PROPOSAL_DISCARDED`. The same `requestId` with the same content returns the version again; other content returns 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`. Audited as `POI_NARRATION_DRAFT_CREATED` or `POI_NARRATION_DRAFT_EDITED`. Requires Staff. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

post.summary: [Tour Staff] Duyệt bản thuyết minh POI
post.description: Approves narration draft `revisionNumber` of POI `id` (ADR-0060). Body `{ requestId, expectedRowVersion }`. The approver must not be the draft's last editor (409 `NARRATION_SELF_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN`); only a `DRAFT` can be approved (409 `NARRATION_NOT_DRAFT`); a stale version returns 409 `STALE_VERSION`, so of two simultaneous approvals one succeeds. The previously approved version becomes `SUPERSEDED` in the same transaction. Route revisions then snapshot this text. Audited as `POI_NARRATION_APPROVED`. Requires Staff. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

post.summary: [Tour Staff] Bỏ bản đang soạn của thuyết minh POI
post.description: Discards narration draft `revisionNumber` of POI `id` without approving it; the row stays as history (ADR-0060). Body `{ requestId, expectedRowVersion }`. Only a `DRAFT` (409 `NARRATION_NOT_DRAFT`); stale 409 `STALE_VERSION`. Audited as `POI_NARRATION_DISCARDED`. Requires Staff. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

get.summary: [Technical Staff] Xem hàng đợi kiểm chứng POI
get.description: Lists submitted current POI revisions that still need a result, optionally filtered by `mapVersionId`. Requires TechnicalStaff. Queue eligibility is based on the current revision and its navigation fingerprint; a prior result remains tied to its revision/fingerprint and is not copied to a changed movement configuration. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

post.summary: [Technical Staff] Ghi nhận PASS/FAIL cho revision POI
post.description: Appends one technical result for proposal `id` and `revisionNumber`. Body includes `requestId`, `expectedRevisionNumber`, `expectedRowVersion`, `robotCode`, `resultCode`, reach/stop/localization/camera observations, and evidence or failure reason. Requires TechnicalStaff. PASS requires all required observations and matching deployed-map evidence for the exact `mapVersionId`/checksum and navigation fingerprint; FAIL requires a failed observation and reason. This is recorded human evidence, not proof the backend executed a physical test. Stale state/already-recorded result returns 409; missing map/robot/proposal returns 404; invalid evidence returns 400. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

get.summary: [Representative] Xem danh sách tour có thể đăng ký
get.description: Lists tours available to the authenticated Representative with standard paging/search filters. Requires Representative JWT. Invalid paging/filter values return 400.

get.summary: [Representative] Xem tour
get.description: Reads tour details by `id` for an authenticated Representative. Requires Representative JWT; missing or inaccessible tour returns 404/403 as enforced by the query.

get.summary: [Representative] Xem danh sách đăng ký của mình
get.description: Lists the current Representative's registrations, optionally filtered by tour, state and group. Requires Representative JWT; results are owner-scoped.

get.summary: [Representative] Xem chi tiết đăng ký của mình
get.description: Reads registration details by `id` for its owning Representative. Requires Representative JWT; another owner's registration is not accessible.

put.summary: [Representative] Cập nhật danh sách theo RowId
put.description: Submits a stable-row diff: each supplied existing `rowId` retains that row, an omitted active row is explicitly removed (and only its own invitation/session is revoked), and an item without `rowId` creates a new PENDING row. Removals and additions may be mixed in one request; unknown/inactive IDs return 409 and duplicate IDs/invalid fields return 400. Accepted-row email changes must use the request/review workflow. Adding is limited to 10 active viewing rows and blocked inside 48 hours; removals remain allowed.Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

post.summary: [Representative] Gửi hồ sơ tối đa 10 điểm xem
post.description: Creates one registration per Representative/Tour with 1–10 viewing-point rows. Shared-screen rows count as one viewing point, not the number of students watching. New rows are PENDING; the 48-hour cutoff is checked under the Tour lock. Requires the owner's Representative JWT and `Idempotency-Key`. Invalid input 400; cutoff/duplicate/state conflict 409; missing Tour 404.Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

post.summary: [Representative] Gửi lại đăng ký
post.description: Resubmits registration `id` after correction using the replacement request. Requires owning Representative JWT and an eligible current state; invalid or conflicting state returns 400/403/409.

post.summary: [Representative] Hủy đăng ký
post.description: Cancels registration `id` using the request/reason. Requires owning Representative JWT and an eligible registration state; missing, unauthorized or conflicting state returns 403/404/409.

post.summary: [Representative] Yêu cầu đổi email của điểm xem
post.description: Creates one pending request per ACCEPTED row with the row ID, old/proposed address, requester and row/Tour/registration versions. Same `requestId` and content replays the existing request ID; a different request while one is PENDING returns 409 `EMAIL_CHANGE_PENDING` and does not replace it. The old email, code and session remain effective until Staff accepts. Request ID makes retries safe; row must be ACCEPTED and Tour SCHEDULED. Invalid input 400; stale/duplicate/reservation state 409; inaccessible row 404.Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

get.summary: [Representative] Xem yêu cầu đổi email của mình
get.description: Lists requests only for a registration owned by the authenticated Representative. It does not show requests from another group or create a Viewer account.Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

post.summary: [Technical Staff] Cấp khóa Fleet Sync lần đầu
post.description: Issues a one-time Fleet Sync secret for an existing PHYSICAL robot that has no active credential. Body includes `requestId` and the robot's current `expectedRowVersion`; replay does not return the secret again. The plaintext is returned once with `Cache-Control: no-store`; only its hash is persisted. Credential metadata, confirmation reset and append-only audit entry commit atomically. Requires TechnicalStaff. Active credential returns 409; non-PHYSICAL or unknown robot returns 404. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

post.summary: [Technical Staff] Cấp lại khóa Fleet Sync
post.description: Replaces the active credential for a PHYSICAL robot, invalidating the old key and atomically clearing first-accepted confirmation. Body includes `requestId` and current `expectedRowVersion`; the new secret is returned once with `Cache-Control: no-store`, and replay never reveals it again. Requires TechnicalStaff. Missing active credential returns 409; stale row version returns 409; unknown robot returns 404. A robot running a Tour returns 409 `ROBOT_IN_RUNNING_TOUR` (ADR-0066 round 5). Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

post.summary: [Technical Staff/Admin] Thu hồi khóa Fleet Sync
post.description: Revokes the active credential without issuing a replacement and atomically clears first-accepted confirmation while appending an audit entry. Body requires `requestId`, `expectedRowVersion` and a non-empty reason up to 500 characters. TechnicalStaff may revoke; Admin may revoke only as an emergency action. No active key returns 409; stale row version returns 409; unknown/non-PHYSICAL robot returns 404. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

get.summary: [Technical Staff/Admin] Xem trạng thái và lịch sử khóa
get.description: Returns safe credential status, issue/revocation metadata, hint and this robot's append-only credential audit history. Never returns plaintext or credential hash. Requires TechnicalStaff or Admin; Staff can read connection status only through the physical robot list. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

get.summary: [Admin] Lọc nhật ký khóa robot
get.description: Lists append-only robot credential audit rows with optional action, robotCode, actorUserId and time-range filters plus `page`. Data contains a safe hint, reason and source, never the secret or hash. Admin only; no edit/delete API exists. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

get.summary: [Staff] Xem trạng thái kết nối robot vật lý
get.description: Returns safe connection state and latest in-memory sync receipt for registered physical robots. Does not expose credential status, metadata, hints, hashes or secrets. Requires Staff. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

get.summary: [Tour Staff/Technical Staff] Liệt kê tuyến VERSIONED
get.description: Pages current revisions of VERSIONED routes only, including unsubmitted drafts; it never mixes legacy catalog rows or emits multiple history rows for one Route. On a voting route (ADR-0065) `traversedStopIds`, the stop ids in the order driven, is required (409 `ROUTE_TEST_ORDER_INVALID`) and the result reads `LEGS_INCOMPLETE` until the PASS runs since the newest FAIL cover every leg. post.summary: [Tour Staff] Gia hạn lease camera của robot
post.description: ADR-0052. No body. Keeps the camera of `robotCode` on for `FleetCamera:LeaseSeconds`; the pre-start check page renews it every 30 s. Returns `data` as `{robotCode, wanted, reason, robotListening, lastPollAt, leaseUntil, stream}`. `stream` is `{whepUrl, token, expiresAt}` (ADR-0055) when the public relay carries this robot, otherwise null; connect to `whepUrl?token=…` before `expiresAt`, and each renewal brings a new token. `robotListening` only means the robot polled within `FleetCamera:RobotListeningWithinSeconds`, not that video is flowing. The lease is held in memory; no SQL write. Requires Staff. Invalid `robotCode` returns 400; unknown robot returns 404. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

get.summary: [Tour Staff] Xem pin và kết nối kính Quest của robot
get.description: ADR-0056. Returns `data` as `{robotCode, reported, connection, batteryPercent, charging, stream, reportedAt, stale, screen}` from the headset report the robot sent with its last camera poll. `connection` is `connected`, `unauthorized`, `offline`, `not_found`, `adb_error` or `unknown`; `stream` is `live`, `connecting`, `paused`, `lost` or null; `screen` is `awake`, `asleep`, `unknown` or null (a quest-stream that does not report it). `reported` is false before the first report; `stale` is true when the last report is older than `FleetCamera:RobotListeningWithinSeconds` (the robot stopped polling, so the battery may be out of date). Held in memory; an API restart forgets it until the next poll. Requires Staff. Invalid `robotCode` returns 400; unknown robot returns 404. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

post.summary: [Tour Staff] Đánh thức hoặc cho kính Quest ngủ
post.description: ADR-0056 addendum. Body `{action}`: `WAKE` (turn the display on and keep it on while nobody wears the headset) or `SLEEP` (display off, saves the battery). The press waits in memory for the robot's next camera poll and is dropped after `FleetCamera:RobotListeningWithinSeconds`; a later press replaces one not yet delivered. Returns `data` as `{robotCode, commandId, action, expiresAt}`; read `GET .../headset` for the resulting `screen`. 409 `HEADSET_ROBOT_NOT_LISTENING` (the robot's quest-stream has not polled recently), `HEADSET_NOT_REPORTED`, `HEADSET_NOT_CONNECTED` (adb is not `connected`), `HEADSET_CONTROL_UNSUPPORTED` (quest-stream on the NUC is too old to report `screen`) or `HEADSET_TOUR_RUNNING` (SLEEP while a Tour runs on the robot). No SQL write, no audit row. Requires Staff. Invalid `robotCode` or `action` returns 400; unknown robot returns 404. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

The versioned Route catalog is `GET /api/routes`. Requires Staff (product label: Tour Staff). Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. To create a versioned Route revision, use `POST /api/staff/routes/{routeId}/revisions`; to view a specific Route's revision, use `GET /api/routes/{routeId}/revisions`. Requires Staff (product label: Tour Staff). get.summary: [Tour Staff] Liệt kê Tour
get.description: Lists persisted Tours with paging and optional state, phase (UPCOMING, RUNNING, FINISHED), and time filters. Each row has a read-only `execution` summary: `operationalStatus`, `assistanceReason`, `currentStep`, `commandState` (the current leg's GoTo, as in the detail) and `needsReconcile` (a GoTo of this Tour is UNKNOWN, also after End Early). A Tour created under ADR-0034 stores an exact RouteRevision, assigned Operator and robot reservation; legacy Tours store none of them, and no Tour has a READY snapshot yet. A listed Tour is not evidence that it is ready to run.

post.summary: [Tour Staff] Tạo Tour
post.description: Creates a SCHEDULED Tour from one exact submitted RouteRevision with an effective PASS run, one physical robot and one active Staff Operator. The robot is held for the whole shift (ADR-0035); the shift must hold the revision's estimated duration (dwell plus straight-line travel at `Tours:EstimatedSpeedMetersPerSecond`), not a typed run length. With `shortNoticeReason` (required for it, at most 500 characters) and no `scheduledStartAt`, it is a quick Tour (ADR-0053): no shift, the robot held from now until the latest Start (now plus `Tours:ShortNoticeMinLeadMinutes`, 30 by default) plus the expected duration plus 15 minutes, published at that latest Start, and Start opens at creation; `SHIFT_BLOCKED` when the hold reaches a closed day or shift. Overlap returns `ROBOT_RESERVATION_CONFLICT` (409); an untested revision returns `ROUTE_TEST_PASS_REQUIRED` (409). A Tour created under ADR-0034 stores an exact RouteRevision, assigned Operator and robot reservation; legacy Tours store none of them, and no Tour has a READY snapshot yet. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

With `quick=true` each row adds `heldByTourName`/`heldUntil` and `quick: {expectedDurationSeconds, startBy, holdStartsAt, holdEndsAt, autoCancelAt}`, what a quick Tour created now would get; `autoCancelAt` is when the system would cancel it unstarted and free the robot (the hold end, never before `startBy` + `FleetCommands:StartLateLimitMinutes`). A preview; create recomputes. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

get.summary: [Staff] Xem ca trống để tạo Tour

Each item has `shiftCode`, `shiftName`, `time` (Tour start, shift opening + 15 minutes), `startsAt`, `reservationStartsAt/EndsAt` (the whole shift), `maxDurationSeconds`, `registrationClosesAt`, and `available` or a `reasonCode` (`LEAD_TIME_TOO_SHORT`, `ROUTE_TOO_LONG_FOR_SHIFT`, `SHIFT_BLOCKED`, `RESERVATION_OVERLAP`) with Vietnamese text. The response carries `recommendedMaxSeconds` and `expectedDurationSeconds`, the revision's estimate (total dwell plus straight-line travel start -> stops -> end at `Tours:EstimatedSpeedMetersPerSecond`, 0.25 by default, rounded up); `measuredDurationSeconds` repeats the same estimate until the column is dropped. Uses the same calculation as create, which rechecks at save. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

get.description: Each stop's narration in the Tour against its POI's newest approved narration, and whether Staff may refresh now (`canRefresh`, else `blockedCode`: TOUR_NARRATION_UP_TO_DATE, TOUR_ROUTE_CHANGED, TOUR_LOCKED, ROUTE_VERSION_REQUIRED). ADR-0067.

post.summary: [Staff] Cập nhật lời thuyết minh mới cho Tour
post.description: Body `{requestId, expectedRowVersion}`. SCHEDULED or READY before Start. Moves the Tour to a revision of its route with the same path and the newest approved narration, saving and submitting one when needed; the applied test run is kept. 409 with the blocked codes above. Audited `TOUR_NARRATION_REFRESHED` (ADR-0067).

post.summary: [Tour Staff] Hủy Tour trước Start
post.description: Cancels a Tour in SCHEDULED or READY state before Start using the current row-version and lifecycle conditions. Cancellation revokes invitation access and closes existing sessions. This endpoint does not perform runtime End Early; no robot reservation exists to release. A Tour created under ADR-0034 stores an exact RouteRevision, assigned Operator and robot reservation; legacy Tours store none of them, and no Tour has a READY snapshot yet. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

post.summary: [Tour Staff] Chuyển Tour sang READY
post.description: Body `{requestId, expectedRowVersion}`. Moves a SCHEDULED versioned Tour to READY after every READY condition of architecture §3.2 passes under the Tour lock (ADR-0042). Any failing condition returns `READY_PRECONDITION_FAILED` (409) with every `blockers` entry; stale version `STALE_VERSION`, reused request `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`. READY locks registration, row review, email change and metadata until Reopen. It does not start the Tour, claim the robot or send a command. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

post.summary: [Tour Staff] Mở lại Tour READY về SCHEDULED
post.description: Body `{requestId, expectedRowVersion, reason}`. Returns a READY Tour that has not started to SCHEDULED and records the reason. Reservation, registrations and invitations are unchanged. Another state returns `TOUR_STATE_INVALID` (409). Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

get.summary: [Tour Staff] Xem checklist trước Start
get.description: Any Staff. Query `holdAtStart=true` answers for opening the Tour without its first leg. Returns `{checks: [{id, passed, source, detail}], canStart, blockedBy}`: the Start conditions of architecture §3.2 evaluated now without locks, from DB, in-memory Fleet Sync telemetry, configuration and console presence (`source` DB, TELEMETRY, CONFIG, CONSOLE). `callerIsOperator` tells whether the viewer is the Tour's Operator and is a root cause for anyone else, while every other check still runs; the four on-site confirmations exist only in Start. `canStart` is the caller's own answer: true only when every returned check passed; `blockedBy` lists root causes only, and a check skipped because another failed shows `passed: false` without being listed. While `FleetCommands:Enabled` is false (the default) `commandTransportEnabled` fails. Missing Tour 404. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

post.summary: [Tour Staff] Start Tour
post.description: Body `{requestId, expectedRowVersion, confirmation: {robotPlaced, areaClear, attendantPresent, previewChecked}, holdAtStart?}`. With `holdAtStart: true` the Tour opens at `INITIALIZING` with no command and no confirmation; `robotLocalized` and `motionReady` are shown, not required; the Operator departs later with `next`, which then needs the confirmations. Only the Tour's Operator (other Staff 403). Start is accepted from `FleetCommands:StartEarlyLimitMinutes` (default 10, at most 15) before the published time (a quick Tour from its creation, when its robot hold opens, ADR-0053) until `StartLateLimitMinutes` (default 15, at most 15) after it; before the published time `allViewersJoined` only reports how many accepted rows are in the waiting room and never blocks (ADR-0050, ADR-0057). Runs every Start check under the Tour lock: a failing check returns 409 `START_PRECONDITION_FAILED` with `errors.checks` and `errors.blockedBy`; if only the command transport is off (the default) it returns 409 `COMMAND_TRANSPORT_DISABLED` with the checks and writes nothing. Otherwise one transaction claims the robot, moves the Tour to RUNNING and stores the first GoTo as PENDING; `ROBOT_CLAIM_FAILED` (409) if the robot just changed, `STALE_VERSION` on an old version. A repeat with the same `requestId` returns the earlier result. Storing a command does not prove a robot moved (ADR-0042, ADR-0043). Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

post.summary: [Tour Staff] Đi tiếp sau POI
post.description: Body `{requestId, expectedRowVersion, confirmation?}`. Only the Tour's Operator (other Staff 403), while RUNNING, NORMAL and OBSERVING, or INITIALIZING after `start` with `holdAtStart` (the departure, which also needs the four on-site confirmations) (`TOUR_STATE_INVALID`) with no open command (`TOUR_COMMAND_OPEN`). Closes the visit, then stores a GoTo to the next stop or the end pose, or completes the Tour and releases the robot when the route ends at its last POI. A new command needs the movement checks: 409 `MOVE_PRECONDITION_FAILED` with `errors.checks` and `errors.blockedBy`. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

post.summary: [Tour Staff] Kết thúc sớm Tour
post.description: Body `{requestId, expectedRowVersion, reason}`. The assigned Operator, or another Staff after the Operator console has been disconnected for Tours:OperatorDisconnectEndEarlyMinutes (default 5); Admin and other roles are forbidden. Rechecked under the Tour lock; 409 OPERATOR_STILL_CONNECTED includes errors.operatorLastSeenAt and errors.allowedAt. Only while RUNNING (TOUR_STATE_INVALID). The Tour becomes CANCELLED. With an open GoTo the robot gets `NeedsInspection = 1` and stays held; with none (stopped at the start, a POI or after a paused leg) it is released. An undelivered GoTo is withdrawn; a delivered or accepted one gets a Cancel; the leg's real result is still recorded later. Nothing in this flow proves the robot stopped; on-site Technical Staff release it. Tour state closes viewer media/Q&A. A generic ended-early email is queued atomically for representatives of groups with accepted rows; no technical reason is emailed. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

post.summary: [Tour Staff] Thử lại chặng
post.description: Body `{requestId, expectedRowVersion}`. Only the Tour's Operator, while NEEDS_ASSISTANCE after a GoTo that FAILED (`NavigationFailed`) or was REJECTED (`CommandRejected`), or PAUSED after a paused leg ended (Resume); otherwise `TOUR_RETRY_NOT_ALLOWED` (409), always for UNKNOWN or RECONCILED. A new GoTo with a new leg to the same target after the movement checks: `MOVE_PRECONDITION_FAILED` (409) with `errors.checks` and `errors.blockedBy`. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

post.summary: [Tour Staff] Tạm dừng chặng
post.description: Body `{requestId, expectedRowVersion}`. Only the Tour's Operator, while RUNNING, NORMAL and on a leg (`NAVIGATING` or `RETURNING_TO_END`, else `TOUR_STATE_INVALID`); not for an UNKNOWN GoTo (`COMMAND_STATE_INVALID`) and not twice (`TOUR_PAUSE_PENDING`). An undelivered GoTo is withdrawn and the Tour is `PAUSED` at once; a delivered one gets a Cancel and the Tour stays NORMAL (`execution.command.cancelRequested`) until the robot reports the leg's end: CANCELLED, FAILED or REJECTED make it `PAUSED`, ARRIVED opens the POI as usual. Resume is `retry-leg` (a new leg to the same target). Not an emergency stop. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

post.summary: [Tour Staff] Khóa điểm tham quan của tuyến bình chọn
post.description: ADR-0065. Body `{reason}` (1–500 characters; every Viewer sees it). Only the Tour's Operator, while the Tour is RUNNING on a route with `viewerChoosesNextStop`, for a POI not yet visited or skipped that is neither the first POI nor the POI the robot is driving to; otherwise 409 `STOP_LOCK_INVALID`. Removes the POI from the open ballot and clears the votes for it; if it was the decided POI and the robot has not left, the next POI is chosen again (`LOCKED_FALLBACK`). Records `STOP_LOCKED`. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

post.summary: [Tour Staff] Mở khóa điểm tham quan của tuyến bình chọn
post.description: ADR-0065. Body `{reason}` (1–500 characters). Only the Tour's Operator, while the Tour is RUNNING, for a locked POI not yet visited; otherwise 409 `STOP_LOCK_INVALID`. The POI becomes a candidate again; a decision already taken stays. Records `STOP_UNLOCKED`. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

post.summary: [Tour Staff] Bỏ qua điểm dừng
post.description: Body `{requestId, expectedRowVersion, confirmation?}`. Only the Tour's Operator, while the robot stands still: at the start (`INITIALIZING`, which also needs the four on-site confirmations), at a POI (`OBSERVING`), or after a paused or failed leg that `retry-leg` could resume (else `TOUR_STATE_INVALID`), with no open command (`TOUR_COMMAND_OPEN`). Skips the POI the robot would go to next (`STOP_SKIPPED` event, `NOTHING_TO_SKIP` when that is the end pose) and goes to the one after it or the end pose, or completes the Tour when the skipped POI was the last of a `LAST_POI` route. Movement checks: `MOVE_PRECONDITION_FAILED` (409) with `errors.checks` and `errors.blockedBy`. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

put.summary: [Tour Staff] Bật/tắt tự đi tiếp tại POI
put.description: Body `{enabled}`. Only the Tour's Operator, while READY or RUNNING (`TOUR_STATE_INVALID`). Off by default and after an API restart (in memory). When on, once a POI's dwell ends the server makes one attempt per visit to leave for the next stop, with every movement check including the Operator's console connection; a blocked attempt moves nothing, is not repeated, and is shown as `execution.autoAdvance.blockedReason`. Returns `{tourId, enabled}`. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

post.summary: [Tour Staff] Đối soát lệnh UNKNOWN
post.description: Body `{requestId, reason}`. Only the Tour's Operator, for an UNKNOWN GoTo of this Tour (`COMMAND_STATE_INVALID`, 409). Records RECONCILED: the real outcome stays unknown, the robot gets `NeedsInspection = 1` and a running Tour stays NEEDS_ASSISTANCE, so only End Early remains. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

post.summary: [Tour Staff] Xoay đầu quay của robot
post.description: ADR-0045. Body `{kind, panSteps, tiltSteps, panDir, tiltDir, panDeg, tiltDeg, sweepDeg}`, at most 4 KB; only the fields of `kind` (STEP, JOG, STOP, ANGLE, SWEEP) may be set; ANGLE stays within pan ±170 and tilt ±18; SWEEP may carry `sweepDeg` (10..170 per side) and makes the head look left, right and back. Only the Tour's Operator (other Staff 403), while the Tour is RUNNING (`TOUR_STATE_INVALID`). 409 `HEAD_CONTROL_DISABLED` while `FleetHead:Enabled = false`; 409 `HEAD_ROBOT_NOT_CONNECTED` when the robot has not polled within `FleetHead:RobotConnectedWithinMs`. Returns `{seq, robotCode, issuedAt}`: queued in memory, not proof the head moved. No SQL write and no per-press audit. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

put.summary: [Tour Staff] Chọn chế độ đầu quay (tự động/bằng tay)
put.description: ADR-0045 addendum. Body `{mode}`: `AUTO` does what each POI's camera preset says at arrival (turn to FRONT/LEFT/RIGHT or a custom angle, sweep left, right and back, or nothing for NONE) and turns the head to the front when Next starts the following leg; `MANUAL` only follows the buttons. Buttons work in both modes and stop a running sweep. Only the Tour's Operator (other Staff 403), until the Tour is COMPLETED or CANCELLED (`TOUR_STATE_INVALID`). In memory: a Tour never set, or any Tour after an API restart, has `FleetHead:DefaultMode` (AUTO). Returns `{tourId, mode}`. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

get.summary: [Tour Staff] Xem trạng thái đầu quay
get.description: ADR-0045. Returns `{enabled, mode, robotCode, connected, lastPollAt, head, headReceivedAt}` for the Tour's robot: whether head control is on, the Tour's head mode (AUTO or MANUAL), whether the robot is polling, and the last head state it reported. Any Staff. A missing Tour returns 404. Read from memory; it is not a Tour state. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

get.description: ADR-0070. Query `epoch` and `after`: messages after seq `after` of that epoch; another or no epoch returns every kept message. Returns `data` as `{epoch, lastSeq, open, canSend, messages}`; each message has `{id, seq, from (STAFF|VIEWER), text, hasAudio, audioAvailable, audioDurationMs, staffName, viewerName, viewerClass, viewerRowType, sentAt}`. Kept in memory on one API instance, at most 300 messages per Tour, forgotten 6 hours after the last one. Not cached. Errors: 400 for invalid input; 401 without a valid JWT; 403 when the JWT role is not allowed; 404 when a referenced record does not exist; 409 when the requested state or concurrency version conflicts. Only statuses applicable to the operation are returned.

post.summary: [Relay] MediaMTX hỏi quyền đọc/phát
post.description: ADR-0055. Called only by the public MediaMTX relay (`authMethod: http`) with `?key=` = `QuestRelay:Key`. Body is MediaMTX's `{user, password, token, ip, action, path, protocol, id, query}`. 204 allows `publish` with the configured publisher credentials, or `read` with a valid unexpired token (the `token` query parameter) whose holder may still watch; 403 refuses; 401 when the key is wrong or `QuestRelay` is not configured. No body, own rate limit.

post.summary: [Relay] Kiểm tra lại một phiên đang xem
post.description: ADR-0055. Called by `mediamtx-relay-reaper` on the relay host every 5 s for each open WebRTC session, with `?key=`. Body `{path, query}`. 204 while the token's holder may still watch (the token's expiry is ignored), 403 when not (the reaper kicks the session), 401 for a wrong key. No body.

get.summary: [Relay] Nguồn video dự phòng cho relay
get.description: ADR-0063. Called only by the relay host's on-demand publisher with `?key=` = `QuestRelay:Key` and `?path=fallback-{tourId}`. 200 `text/plain` with the signed Cloudinary URL of the Tour's uploaded fallback video while the Tour is RUNNING; 403 when there is none or `Cloudinary` is not configured; 401 for a wrong key. Not cached.

post.summary: [Viewer] Tham gia tour bằng lời mời
post.description: Exchanges an access code for the tour-scoped HttpOnly Viewer session cookie. No Viewer account or JWT is created. Requires an eligible invitation and allowed request origin; code/eligibility failures return 400/401/403, and join rate limiting may return 429.

post.summary: [Viewer] Khôi phục phiên tour
post.description: Validates the session cookie and its browser-bound device cookie, or the device cookie alone after a network reconnect. Reconnect/heartbeat is allowed only when the active session was last seen within 2 minutes; the configured 10-minute idle lease does not extend this reconnect grace. A session cookie for an older session cannot bypass the grace window. One invitation has at most one active browser session; another browser cannot take it over. Missing, expired, revoked or out-of-window credentials are rejected.

post.summary: [Viewer] Rời phiên tour
post.description: Ends the current tour-scoped Viewer session and clears its cookie. Anonymous cookie-based endpoint; session revocation affects subsequent requests.

post.summary: [Viewer] Gửi câu hỏi riêng trong tour
post.description: Answers a question for `tourId` using the Viewer session cookie. Body includes `questionId`, `text` and optional recent turns; access and current per-session limits are enforced server-side. Invalid request/session returns 400/401/403; rate limits may return 429. This does not imply the future instance-wide 8/20 admission target is implemented.

get.summary: [Viewer] Xem nội dung tour và tiến độ
get.description: Returns route/progress information for `tourId` after validating its Viewer session cookie. No account or bearer JWT is used. Missing, expired or revoked session is rejected; response is not cached.

put.summary: [Viewer] Bình chọn điểm tham quan tiếp theo
put.description: ADR-0065. Viewer session cookie only. Body `{stopVisitId, stopId}`. One vote per roster row per ballot (a shared-screen row has one too), changed in place until the ballot closes; a new session of the same row changes the same vote. Accepted only while the Tour is RUNNING and observing at the POI of `stopVisitId`, its ballot is open and before the dwell deadline: otherwise 409 `VOTE_CLOSED`; a visited, locked or unknown POI returns 409 `VOTE_CANDIDATE_INVALID`. Returns `data` as the ballot (same shape as `ballot` of the view). Missing, expired or revoked session returns 401. Not cached.

get.summary: [Viewer] Lấy địa chỉ và token xem hình trực tiếp
get.description: ADR-0055. Viewer session cookie only. Returns `data` as `{whepUrl, token, expiresAt}` (token life `QuestRelay:TokenSeconds`, default 120 s, at most 300) while the Tour is RUNNING on the relay's robot or SCHEDULED/READY with a reservation on it; the page connects to `whepUrl?token=…` and asks again before `expiresAt`. Missing, expired or revoked session returns 401; a Tour that ended, was cancelled or uses another robot, or a server without `QuestRelay`, returns 409 `STREAM_NOT_AVAILABLE`. Not cached.

get.summary: [Viewer] Lấy địa chỉ và token xem video dự phòng
get.description: ADR-0063. Viewer session cookie only. While the Tour is RUNNING and has a fallback video, returns `data` as `{whepUrl, token, expiresAt}` for the relay path `fallback-{tourId}`; the page connects to `whepUrl?token=…` when the live picture is lost and asks again before `expiresAt`. The video's own address never reaches the browser. Missing, expired or revoked session returns 401; a Tour that is not RUNNING, has no fallback video, or a server without `QuestRelay`, returns 409 `FALLBACK_NOT_AVAILABLE`. Not cached.
